source: docs/specs/03_gameplay/06_historical_path_and_ai.md (How the AI follows or diverges; AI strategy plans; war direction; peace) and docs/specs/03_gameplay/05_world_tension_and_endings.md (AI: the tier rules of the Gathering Dark; the world tick's step 10). The focus order of each plan is derived from the tree's own historical marks (docs/design/focus/<tree>.json); the research and law weights below are proposed. Each tree names the power whose per-power rule decides it: 'branch' is the rule wrapper that already folds DEFAULT under the historical path into the historical branch, 'default' a per-power rule without a historical branch (the plan then needs that rule at DEFAULT), 'dark' the dark powers' appointed route, and 'none' the path rule alone. A power whose owner maps PLAUSIBLE to its free branch (R6: the owner wins) gets no plausible plan.

widget.note: The native world tension widget (topbar threat button and value, the world_tension_popup window) relabelled as the Gathering Dark (docs/specs/07_interface/01_interface.md; spec 05 'Replacing world tension'). Every value keeps its vanilla key's placeholders, colour and icon codes. The exact meter, its tier and its sources are the Aoaz bar's (interface owner); the native widget shows the engine tension that follows the meter. The two column labels of the popup (WORLD_TENSION_NAME, WORLD_TENSION_WARS) are short because its sort buttons are 100 pixels wide: the MCP render wrapped The Gathering Dark and Wars of the Living onto two lines.

labels.HINT_WORLD_TENSION_TEXT:
This is the £world_tension_icon  §YGathering Dark§! of the age, where every deed that frightens the courts of Aoaz is written down: wars declared, crowns taken, realms swallowed and the stranger things the old powers do.

While the dark is thin, most realms may not move against a neighbour without a §Ygood cause§!, and those who break the peace are punished for it; as it deepens, leagues gather, causes come easily and old refusals give way.

Crowns raise it by war and conquest and by some of their §Ychosen courses§!, and a long peace lowers it again.

The deeper it runs, the nearer the age comes to the War of the Last Crowns.
